topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I never thought my words would be out there, exposed like this. Staring at the screen, I see my application essay, the one I poured my heart into, now branded as an example. My hands shake a little as I scroll through the pages, each line a reminder of the nights I spent perfecting it. How many others have read this? What must they think? I need to do something, but the cursor blinks mockingly, a silent judge in this digital courtroom. I can't just sit here. But what choice do I have?
